f.title: Update the investigator brochure whenever significant new information becomes available
f.statement: The sponsor shall update the investigator brochure at any time when new significant information becomes available.

f.title: Ensure sufficient non-clinical and clinical safety data support the proposed human exposure
f.statement: The sponsor shall ensure that sufficient safety and efficacy data from pre-clinical studies and/or clinical trials are available to support human exposure by the route, at the dosages, for the duration and in the trial population to be studied.

rows.quote:

duration, and in the trial population to be studied.
rows.review_note: Review: shall = Mandatory; safety-related sponsor duty at trial design. Double-check: borderline PV (pre-trial safety basis); 88.

f.title: Keep all clinical trial records for at least twenty years after trial completion
f.statement: Without prejudice to any regulation, the investigator and sponsor shall keep in safe custody all records, documents and information related to a clinical trial at the clinical trial site for not less than twenty years after completion of the trial.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Clinical safety monitoring

f.title: Maintain records of all adverse events of the investigational product inside or outside Tanzania
f.statement: The sponsor shall, in respect of the use of an investigational medicinal product in a clinical trial, maintain records of all adverse events of the investigational medicinal product that have occurred inside or outside Tanzania mainland, including information specifying the indication for use and the dosage form at the time of the adverse event; together with all versions of the investigator brochure and records of each change to it, with its rationale and supporting documentation.

f.title: Keep enrolment records so all participants can be contacted if the product may endanger health
f.statement: The sponsor shall maintain records of the enrolment of clinical trial participants, including information sufficient to enable all participants to be identified and contacted in the event that the sale of the investigational medicinal product may endanger the health of the participants or other persons.

f.title: Notify the Authority of discontinuation within 15 days and warn investigators of potential risks
f.statement: Where a sponsor discontinues a clinical trial in its entirety or at a site, the sponsor shall inform the Authority not later than fifteen days after the date of discontinuation, give the reason and its impact, inform all investigators as soon as possible of the discontinuation and reasons and advise them in writing of any potential risks to the health of participants or other persons, and stop use or importation of the investigational product at discontinued sites and recover unused quantities.

f.title: Principal investigator must immediately report any serious adverse event to the Authority
f.statement: The principal investigator shall immediately report to the Authority any serious adverse event occurring in a study participant at a site for which he is responsible; the immediate report may be oral or written.
f.applicability: Serious adverse events in trial participants at Tanzanian sites
f.exceptions: Not applicable to SAEs specified in the protocol or investigator brochure (reg. 18(4)).

f.title: Submit a detailed written SAE report within fourteen days
f.statement: Following the immediate report, the investigator shall make a detailed written report on the serious adverse event within fourteen days.

f.title: SAEs listed in the protocol or investigator brochure are exempt from immediate reporting
f.statement: The immediate and detailed SAE reporting duties in sub-regulations (1) to (3) do not apply to serious adverse events specified in the protocol or the investigator brochure.

f.title: Report AEs identified in the protocol as critical to safety evaluation
f.statement: Adverse events other than those covered by sub-regulations (1) to (3) that are identified in the protocol as critical to evaluations of the safety of the clinical trial shall be reported to the Authority.

f.title: Identify participants in AE reports only by a unique protocol number
f.statement: Reports under sub-regulations (1), (3) and (5) shall identify each participant by the number assigned in accordance with the protocol, which shall differ from the number of any other participant in the trial, including at other sites; the Authority may require additional information where the event consists of or results in the death of a participant.

f.title: Contravening the regulations is an offence under the Act
f.statement: Any person who contravenes any provision of these Regulations, including the safety reporting duties, shall be guilty of an offence under the Act; the Authority may compound offences by accepting a fine.
